create_moonshine_asr_model: create a MoonshineForConditionalGeneration model for automatic speech recognition with audio input and text output
run_moonshine_inference: run inference with MoonshineModel to transcribe audio input_values through encoder-decoder architecture
build_moonshine_encoder: build a MoonshineEncoder with conv1d feature extraction layers and transformer encoder layers for audio processing
build_moonshine_decoder: build a MoonshineDecoder with self-attention, cross-attention, and SwiGLU-style MLP for sequence generation
